title: Spending 10 months building the most human-like chess bot
summary: The author spent 10 months developing a chess bot designed to mimic human playing patterns rather than playing optimally, focusing on making it feel like playing against a real human with realistic mistakes and decision-making processes.
problem_solved: Creates a chess bot that plays like a human with believable weaknesses, blunders, and style variations instead of perfect machine play.
why_valuable: Provides a more natural and enjoyable chess experience for players who want to practice against an opponent that feels authentically human.
